Name: Profession Books
Author: tlitookilakin
Description:
Profession Books adds readable books that grant professions. Each skill has its own book, and grants a random, unowned profession for that skill when used, or some XP for that skill if all professions are owned. These books are available after unlocking mastery. The Bookseller will sell up to three random skill books, and there's a 1/10 chance for the traveling merchant to sell a random skill book. Skill books will display the "read" indicator once all professions for that skill are owned.

Profession Books supports all custom skills added through spacecore, as well as the new level 10+ professions from Vanilla Plus Professions. For mod developers, it also offers a c# API for registering new skills and professions.
